lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five visible vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin insertion, with spacing increasing toward the ventral surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect horizontal rows of primary blobs to create a rectilinear grid-like appearance across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient, characterized by high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a shadow-cast gradient on the ventral edge.
